name: hook_counter
description: An opening that stops the scroll with a number: it counts up from zero to the figure, a bold label slams down under it, stars twinkle, and a short line may follow. For the first words when they carry a number - a result, a price, a count of customers, a percentage, a sum of money. Only a number that was said or is in the brief.

value.description: The number with what goes before or after it, grouped with spaces, e.g. '$1 000 000', '50%', '+300', '1 200 soʻm'.

pill.description: Optional: one or two words that slam down under the number, e.g. 'MIJOZ', 'CHEGIRMA'. Written in capitals by the code.

chip.description: Optional: a short line that rises in last, e.g. 'Faqat shu hafta'.

beats.land: The word on which the count reaches the number - usually the number itself.
beats.slam: The word the label slams down on.
beats.rise: The word the short line rises in on.
